stochastic_expert_utility: disease-level arithmetic mean across frozen seeds 0/1/2
applicability: explicit frozen expert applicability; known before invocation; unavailable expert cannot be selected and incurs zero invocation cost
cascade: one default expert followed by at most one additional expert; escalation replaces final ranking
lambda_objective: mean Recall@50 - lambda * mean marginal seconds
gate_interpretation: characterize oracle economic headroom first; do not train probes until Gate A is interpreted
